name: glitchband
description: A band above the prompt: 7-day and 5-hour usage, prompt cache WARM or COLD with the price of the next message, and keepwarm to hold the cache.

language.title: Language
language.description: en (default), or auto to follow Claude Code's language setting, then the system locale; it for Italian

compactBelow.title: Compact below (columns)
compactBelow.description: Under this many columns the wide row drops the word left and folds keepwarm into its button

cardScale.title: Card text scale
cardScale.description: How much larger the cache card's text reads; 1 is the plain layout

keepwarmWindow.title: Keepwarm window
keepwarmWindow.description: What the band button and a bare /keepwarm arm, as hours and minutes: 6h, 90m, 2h30m

coldGuard.title: Cold-send guard
coldGuard.description: Hold back a message sent on a cold cache once, with its price; off lets it through untouched
